title: AW28 Men's Design and Production Innovations
summary: Design and production for AW28: the first winter planned under the EU passport timeline; repair and data by design.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 fabric fairs take place in September 2027 and the shows in early 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fabric fairs, SS28 previews and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: - The EU textiles Digital Product Passport delegated act is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027, so AW28 production will be planned under it<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Actions
sections.body:
- Product data from the first sample.
- Repairable construction.
- Fibre and origin records.

design_implications: - Record fibre, origin, care and test results for every style.
commercial_implications: - Plan production around Lunar New Year and EU product-data rules.

sources.title: Fashion: 2027, the year growth will finally have to be profitable
